question: Can an OPEN basket be reconstructed solely from durable records + broker positions, with zero in-memory state?

proof.method: write a full open+close lifecycle to a temp DB, close the ledger, open a BRAND-NEW BasketLedger on the same file (simulated restart), run integrity_check and reconstruct_basket

reconstructed.events: >= 9 (intent, entry attempt, 3 fills, open verified, exit signal, exit attempt, closed verified)

reconstruction_rule: reconstruct_basket replays events_for(basket_id) in seq order: last new_state is the basket state; BASKET_INTENT_CREATED payload supplies direction/entry fields; LEG_FILL_CONFIRMED payloads supply leg tickets/prices.
materialized_cache: basket_current is a derived cache updated in the same transaction; it is verified against events at startup and is never the source of truth.
